en.hubeali:
Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Hassan Bin Ali, from one of our companions, from Saeed Al A’araj, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The man, when he sees the crescent of Zil Qadah, and he intends the going, should neither take (hair) from his head not from his beard’.
en.sarwar: 4. Ahmad ibn Muhammad has narrated from al-Hassan ibn Ali from certain persons of our people from Sa‘id al-‘Araj who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
A man who wants to go for al-Hajj must not remove any hair from his head or beard in the month of Dhu al-Qa’dah.’”
